# Soft Tech Solution

> UK-registered software studio that builds AI assistants, automation systems and custom apps for online sellers and small businesses — WhatsApp AI assistants, COD order confirmation, booking and reminder systems, TikTok Shop tools, custom web/mobile/desktop apps and government office systems. Visitors can try 24 working demos before they pay.

This file is generated from the same data files the website uses (src/data/*.ts). Every project listed is real; statuses are stated honestly.

## Facts

- Company: Soft Tech Solution, a brand operated by Atlantic LTD STORE LIMITED, a company registered in England and Wales.
- Founder: Imtiaz Ahmad, founder and lead engineer (https://www.linkedin.com/in/imtiazahmad004).
- Clients: businesses in the United Kingdom and Pakistan. Languages: English and Urdu.
- Proof of work: 18 projects at https://aisofttechsolution.com/work and 24 interactive demos at https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos.
- Pricing model: fixed-price proposals after a free 30-minute discovery call; no hourly billing; no published price list.
- Typical timelines: landing page 1–2 weeks, full web app 4–8 weeks, larger systems 3–6 months.
- Support: 30 days of free post-launch support; Basic, Standard or Premium plans after that.
- Contracts: NDA before confidential discussion; 100% IP assignment to the client.
- Payment descriptor: charges appear as "AI SOFT TECH SOLUTION", processed by Atlantic LTD STORE LIMITED.
- Contact: info@aisofttechsolution.com · WhatsApp UK +44 7462 086661 · WhatsApp Pakistan +92 300 5863032. Open Monday to Saturday, 24 hours (closed Sunday). Replies within 24 hours.

## Services

- **WhatsApp & website AI assistants** — An AI assistant trained on your prices, timings and policies answers customers on WhatsApp and your website, takes orders and bookings, and hands the conversation to a person when it should. For: Restaurants, clinics, salons, shops and online stores that lose customers to unanswered messages. Examples: BizBot demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/bizbot), FoodBot demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/foodbot), SupportAI demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/supportai).
- **Booking, reminder & payment-collection systems** — Appointments without double bookings, digital queue tokens, and automatic WhatsApp reminders for fees, rent, invoices, refills and services — with a dashboard that shows who has paid. For: Salons, clinics, pharmacies, schools, landlords, workshops and freelancers. Examples: SalonBook demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/salonbook), ClinicToken demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/clinictoken), FeeChaser demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/feechaser).
- **E-commerce & TikTok Shop tools** — COD order confirmation, automatic TikTok Shop fulfilment, one dashboard for several shops, order-status bots and product research — the tools online sellers need once orders start piling up. For: Online sellers in Pakistan and TikTok Shop sellers and agencies in the UK. Examples: CODConfirm demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/codconfirm), TikFulfill demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/tikfulfill), ProfitScout (https://aisofttechsolution.com/profitscout).
- **Custom web, mobile & desktop apps** — CRMs, digital khata and profit dashboards, school management, ride-booking apps and offline Windows tools — built for your workflow, with your data in your hands. For: Businesses that have outgrown notebooks, spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups. Examples: KhataBook demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/khatabook), LeadCRM demo (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/leadcrm), All projects (https://aisofttechsolution.com/work).
- **Business websites & 3D experiences** — Clean business websites with service pages, reviews and WhatsApp booking built in — or an immersive 3D site when you want to stand out. For: Clinics, firms and local businesses that need to be found and trusted online. Examples: 3D dental website (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/family-dental/), Website demos (https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos).
- **Government & office systems** — Emergency coordination, file tracking and reporting systems for district offices — every case logged once, routed to the right officer, and tracked until it is closed. For: District administrations, control rooms and government departments. Examples: District Nerve Center (https://aisofttechsolution.com/work#district-nerve-center).

## Products and projects

- **District Nerve Center (DNC)** (Government system; status: In daily use) — Emergency coordination platform for a district control room in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — in daily use. Every emergency reported in the district is logged once, sent to the responsible department and officer on WhatsApp, and must be acknowledged within a set time or it escalates automatically. Supervisors see every open case in one command view and download response-time reports. Designed with the control room staff around how they actually work. Built with TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, WhatsApp alerts.
- **Soft Clipper** (Desktop app; status: Live product) — Windows app that turns long videos into ready-to-post vertical clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. AI finds the strongest moments in a long video, reframes them to 9:16 while keeping the speaker in frame, burns in captions and exports finished clips. Sold as a one-time purchase through its own website. Built with Python, FastAPI, React, Gemini. live: https://softclipper.pro
- **ProfitScout** (Chrome extension; status: Live product) — Free Chrome extension for product research on Amazon, eBay, TikTok Shop, Walmart and Etsy. Analyses listings in the browser with an X-Ray niche scanner, ROI calculator, price tracker, lead manager and Gemini-powered insights. No sign-up; data stays in the browser. Built with JavaScript, Chrome Extension, Gemini. page: https://aisofttechsolution.com/profitscout
- **SellOps** (SaaS; status: Completed) — Operations dashboard for TikTok Shop agencies and Etsy sellers. Revenue tracking, creator management, invoicing and payroll for TikTok Shop agencies, plus AI niche research and listing generation for Etsy — in one login. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL (Neon), Better Auth, Claude API.
- **Composer — AI Document Scanner** (AI tool; status: Live) — Extracts text from photos and scans in 10+ languages; installs as an app on phone or desktop. Upload one or many pages and get clean, editable text back. Uses Gemini with an EasyOCR fallback and runs as a progressive web app. Built with Python, Streamlit, Gemini, OCR. live: https://composer.aisofttechsolution.com
- **Family Dental — 3D Clinic Website** (Website; status: Live) — Immersive 3D scroll website for a dental clinic, with an on-page booking assistant. Visitors take a tooth apart layer by layer, explore treatments in interactive 3D and book through a chat assistant. A second, simpler version covers 15 treatment pages for clinics that want speed over spectacle. Built with Three.js, GSAP, Vite. live: https://aisofttechsolution.com/demos/family-dental/
- **Dir Ride** (Mobile app; status: In development) — Bike-taxi app for Timergara that replaces booking rides through WhatsApp groups. One Flutter app for customers and riders with role-based screens, a Supabase backend and a Next.js admin dashboard with Google Maps. Built with Flutter, Supabase, Next.js, Google Maps.
- **Fixr AI** (AI agent; status: Hackathon build) — Voice-first booking agent for local services like AC repair, electricians and plumbers. Five cooperating agents (intent, discovery, ranking, booking, follow-up) turn a spoken request in English, Roman Urdu or Urdu into a confirmed booking, with a visible trace of every decision. Built for the Google Antigravity Hackathon 2026. Built with Node.js, Multi-agent, Web Speech API, Leaflet.
- **Etsy Automation Tool** (E-commerce automation; status: Prototype) — From niche research to a published Etsy listing: research, product files and auto-listing. Claude scores niches for demand and competition, scans top sellers for gaps, writes titles, descriptions and 13 tags, generates the PDF/SVG/PNG product files and publishes through the official Etsy API with seller consent. Built with FastAPI, React, Claude API, Etsy API.
- **School Finance System** (Desktop app; status: Completed) — Offline fee management for schools on Windows — no internet needed. Student records, fee collection, receipts and payment tracking, shared across the school network from one PC. One-click setup. Built with Python, Flask, SQLite, Windows.
- **Nursify — Nursing Study Assistant** (EdTech; status: Completed) — Turns a nursing student’s own slides and notes into summaries, MCQs and a study plan. Answers and questions are generated strictly from the uploaded material, so students revise what their course actually covers. Built with React, Gemini, Firebase.
- **ProfitFlow** (Finance tool; status: Completed) — Profit & loss and balance-sheet reports for small businesses, built from uploaded statements. AI reads bank and sales statements, categorises entries and produces P&L and balance-sheet PDFs a shop owner can hand to an accountant. Built with React, Express, SQLite, Gemini.
- **Smart Education — School Management** (Web app; status: Completed) — School management system with separate portals for admin, staff and guardians. Admissions and onboarding, role-based operations, fee and finance records, staff directory and Gemini-powered analytics. Built with React, Firebase, Gemini.
- **Niche Researcher** (AI tool; status: Completed) — Finds similar YouTube channels and the topics trending in a niche over the last 24 hours. Scrapes channel data and uses Gemini to surface peak-performing videos, rising topics and look-alike creators. Built with React, Express, Gemini.
- **FormulaWizard** (AI tool; status: Prototype) — Write what you want in plain English and get the Excel formula. Generates and explains complex spreadsheet formulas from a plain-language request. Built with React, Gemini.
- **VoxGen** (AI tool; status: Completed) — Text-to-speech app with several natural-sounding voices. Gemini-powered speech generation with voice selection and natural prosody. Built with React, Gemini TTS.
- **ReportAnalyzer AI** (AI tool; status: Hackathon build) — Upload a report and get a command-centre view of its findings. Hackathon build that reads long reports and turns them into a structured dashboard of key points and actions. Built with React, Express, Gemini.
- **Googly Eyes for Windows** (AI agent; status: Prototype) — A voice desktop companion on an Android phone that can point at and operate a Windows PC. Talks through OpenAI Realtime and, when asked, uses the computer — with a master kill switch (Ctrl+Alt+S), a self-check mode and guardrails on every action. Built with C#, Kotlin, OpenAI Realtime.

## FAQs

**Can I see your work before hiring you?**
Yes. You can try 24 working demos at aisofttechsolution.com/demos and see the products we built and run at /work.

**How long does a typical project take?**
Project timelines vary by scope. A landing page takes 1–2 weeks, a full web app 4–8 weeks, and larger systems 3–6 months. We give you a detailed timeline during the free consultation before any work begins.

**How does your pricing work?**
We price per project, not per hour. After your free discovery call, we send a fixed-price proposal scoped to your requirements. No surprise invoices. For ongoing work, we offer monthly retainer arrangements.

**What technologies do you use?**
React and TypeScript for web apps, Node.js and Python (FastAPI, Flask) on the server, PostgreSQL, Supabase or Firebase for data, Flutter for mobile apps, and Gemini, Claude and OpenAI models for AI features. We pick what fits your project and budget.

**Can you integrate AI into my existing business?**
Yes — this is our core work. We build WhatsApp and website assistants that answer from your own business information, document readers that turn photos and PDFs into text, and automations that confirm orders or send reminders inside the tools you already use.

**Do you work with clients in the UK and Pakistan?**
Yes. The company is registered in England and Wales as Atlantic LTD STORE LIMITED, and we work with clients in the UK and Pakistan over WhatsApp (+44 7462 086661 and +92 300 5863032), email and video calls.

**Do you offer ongoing support after launch?**
Yes. Every project comes with 30 days of free post-launch support. After that we offer Basic (bug fixes only), Standard (monthly updates + monitoring) and Premium (dedicated developer on-call) plans.

**Can you work with an existing codebase?**
Yes. We regularly audit, refactor and extend existing systems, starting with a technical review to identify risks before writing new code.

**Do you sign NDAs and IP agreements?**
Yes. We sign NDAs before any confidential discussion and full IP assignment agreements are included in every project contract. You own 100% of the code, designs and assets we produce for you.

**How do we get started?**
Message us on WhatsApp or use the contact form with two lines about your project. We reply within 24 hours and book a free 30-minute discovery call. No commitment required at that stage.

**Why does AI SOFT TECH SOLUTION appear on my bank statement?**
AI SOFT TECH SOLUTION is our payment statement descriptor. Payments for Soft Tech Solution are processed by Atlantic LTD STORE LIMITED. Soft Tech Solution is operated by Atlantic LTD STORE LIMITED.
